import pandas as pd
import scipy.stats as stats

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv')

# Extract the relevant columns
original_avg_citations = df['author_citations_avg.o']
replication_avg_citations = df['author_citations_avg.r']
original_max_citations = df['author_citations_max.o']
replication_max_citations = df['author_citations_max.r']

# Perform descriptive statistics
original_avg_stats = original_avg_citations.describe()
replication_avg_stats = replication_avg_citations.describe()
original_max_stats = original_max_citations.describe()
replication_max_stats = replication_max_citations.describe()

# Perform t-tests
t_test_avg = stats.ttest_ind(original_avg_citations, replication_avg_citations)
t_test_max = stats.ttest_ind(original_max_citations, replication_max_citations)

original_avg_stats, replication_avg_stats, original_max_stats, replication_max_stats, t_test_avg, t_test_max
